rules.text: If each category’s adjacent percentage inscription is the dashboard’s current labeled rating share and the inscription-to-category attachment is correct, then the category with the greatest such inscription is the category required by the follow-up rule; if that category is Design, the corresponding public option is Select Design.
rules.conditions: Applies only if the visible percentage labels are authoritative current labeled rating shares and their category attachments are correctly read.

observations.location: scatter point above the x-axis label Design
observations.content: The point aligned with the x-axis inscription "Design" has the adjacent inscription "52%".

observations.location: scatter points above the x-axis labels Quality, Price, Support, Delivery, and Other
observations.content: The visible adjacent inscriptions are "24%" for Quality, "10%" for Price, "45%" for Support, "39%" for Delivery, and "32%" for Other.

task_evidence.content: Select the category with the highest current labeled rating share

chains.claim: Conditionally, the visible 52% inscription attached to Design exceeds every other visible category percentage inscription, so Design is the highest current labeled rating-share category and Select Design is supported.
